name: as if
source:
neurotic loner restores and circuitbends computer

this is an 18+ visual novel made for vncup 2, slowly worked on from june 18 to july 16, 2023.

they heralded the new space as "alba", a nod to the algrev series of home computers, but mainly playing on the old occitan poetry genre. the image of a hacker, having worked on a project through the night, being found when someone came in to open the space in the morning. forcing the hacker and project to separate so the hacker could get some rest.

[From [url=https://ddqawa.itch.io/as-if]itch.io[/url]]
